items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: This Bespawn(?) and Hill had sold them a bill of goods that he had a helluva good band from New Orleans. They advertised us as the Original Dixieland Jazz Band, you see.

ctx.x: Okay, now we can pick up from where you were talking about Ory had just left Los Angeles.

Yeah. This guy comes through here looking for a band, a guy out of Houston, Texas, looking for a band to go to Oakland and San Francisco, named Toby Mitchell. He was representing two guys out of Oakland, a Jewish guy named Ben Bespawn(?) I think was his name, and another guy named Charlie Hill, I believe, who was a colored guy that had a restaurant in Oakland.
